Idorsia is a leading biopharmaceutical company driven by scientific innovation. As we advance our portfolio and strategic ambitions, effective communication, a strong corporate brand, and meaningful stakeholder engagement are critical to our success.

We are seeking an experienced communications leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. In our lean, high-performing team, success requires someone who is equally comfortable shaping strategy and personally creating content, building digital experiences, and developing high-quality branded materials. Reporting into Corporate Communications & Investor Relations, you will lead corporate brand, digital communications, and corporate storytelling initiatives that strengthen and protect Idorsia's reputation among employees, investors, media, partners, and the broader public.

What You'll Do

• Develop and execute integrated corporate communications, brand, and digital strategies aligned with business priorities.

• Shape compelling corporate narratives and thought leadership content for key stakeholder audiences.

• Partner with senior leaders on executive communications, reputation management, and stakeholder engagement.

• Lead and evolve Idorsia's corporate brand, ensuring consistent messaging and visual identity across all channels.

• Drive digital communications, including hands-on management of corporate websites, social media, and digital content platforms.

• Personally create and oversee high-quality communication materials such as presentations, videos, digital content, and branded assets.

• Advise senior stakeholders on communications strategy, audience engagement, and reputation-building opportunities.

What You'll Bring

• Advanced degree in Communications, Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• Significant experience in corporate communications, branding, reputation management, and digital communications within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry.

• Proven ability to develop integrated communication strategies and lead multi-channel engagement programs.

• Strong expertise in corporate storytelling, executive communications, and digital content.

• Hands-on experience managing websites, and content management systems, developing digital content, and creating corporate communications materials.

• Proficiency with graphic design and content creation tools (e.g. Adobe Creative Suite) is highly desirable.

• Excellent writing, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to balance strategic leadership with practical execution in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent English communication skills; additional languages are a plus.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to play a central role in how Idorsia communicates with the world. Working at the intersection of corporate reputation, brand, and digital engagement, you will help shape the narratives, experiences, and channels that influence how key stakeholders understand our company, our strategy, and our ambitions. As part of a small, collaborative team, you will have broad exposure across the organization and the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to the company's continued evolution and success.

Location: Allschwil, Switzerland
Function: Corporate Communications & Investor Relations
Type: Full-time, Permanent

Job ID: 4830

At Idorsia, we harness the power of difference, authenticity, and inclusion to achieve business success.

We encourage all potential candidates with diverse backgrounds of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, and disability to submit their job applications. All applicants will receive consideration.

We are committed to fostering respect, fairness, and equal opportunities for all job applicants and our employees.

Please be informed that if you are selected for this position, your employment will be subject to a pre-employment background screening process, of which you would be informed in greater detail in due course.

Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd ("Idorsia") is committed to a fair and transparent application process. In order to avoid any conflict of interest in line with Idorsia Code of Business Conduct, which would undermine such a commitment, the applicants must disclose any personal, financial, or other outside interests interfering with the interests of Idorsia. descriptionByLocale.it:
Ci piacerebbe darti il benvenuto nel nostro team di Allschwil / Svizzera come

Direttore associato Mercato Accesso e Affari Pubblici DACH (m/f/d)

(a tempo pieno; permanente)

A proposito di Idorsia

Lo scopo di Idorsia è quello di scoprire, sviluppare e portare farmaci più innovativi ai pazienti. Abbiamo più idee; vediamo più opportunità e vogliamo aiutare più pazienti. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, vorremmo sviluppare Idorsia in una delle principali aziende biofarmaceutiche europee, con un forte nucleo scientifico.

Idorsia ha sede in Svizzera e ha già stabilito operazioni commerciali negli Stati Uniti, in Canada e nelle principali sedi strategiche in Europa.

Con le operazioni commerciali per la regione DACH con sede a Monaco / Germania e Allschwil / Svizzera, stiamo aiutando a realizzare l'ambizione di Idorsia di portare farmaci innovativi da panchina a comodino.

Per maggiori informazioni vedere www.idorsia.com

Profilo del lavoro

Le responsabilità dell'accesso al mercato del direttore associato e degli affari pubblici DACH (m/f/d) includono:

• Si concentra sul coordinamento e sull’esecuzione della strategia di accesso di Idorsia e sulla sua attuazione (gestione dei progetti, supervisiona la scrittura dei dossier, le linee temporali, i rischi ecc.) per l’area terapeutica definita.

• Assicura la vestibilità locale della proposizione del valore del prodotto (incluse le prove) per ottenere scenari e risultati ottimali di prezzi e rimborso.

• Rappresenta Idorsia nei confronti di agenzie esterne locali e di altri soggetti interessati, ad esempio gruppi di lavoro di associazioni farmaceutiche e gruppi di consulenza dei pazienti.

• Contribuisce attivamente ai processi interni dell'Idorsia e contribuisce in modo significativo allo sviluppo concettuale e all'attuazione delle strategie di accesso al mercato e di affari pubblici del paese.

• Scambia regolarmente informazioni con il Senior Market Access e Public Affairs Director DACH e i team di progetto interfunzionali.

•
Promuovere lo sviluppo e l'attuazione delle strategie di paese per sostenere l'accesso al mercato DACH e gli affari pubblici.

•
Monitora il relativo ambiente di politica regionale e comprende le principali tendenze sanitarie e il loro impatto.

•
Costruisce e mantiene relazioni a lungo termine in tutta l'organizzazione Idorsia DACH e con le controparti regionali esterne.

•
Assicurare l'adesione a tutti i relativi requisiti legali, regolamentari e sanitari, politiche aziendali e procedure, e guidare questa cultura nell'organizzazione locale.

Requisiti

• Con successo completato un grado idealmente in economia sanitaria, farmacia, o scienza, o qualifica equivalente.

• Minimo 7 anni di esperienza professionale di successo in DACH Market Access, e 10 anni nel settore farmaceutico.

• Una conoscenza approfondita e un'ampia esperienza di Market Access (il tedesco AMNOG è un must, la Svizzera un vantaggio) idealmente in un ambiente farmaceutico innovativo.

• Conoscenze e esperienze comprovate nell'accesso al mercato, nei prezzi e nei rimborsi sui mercati DACH attraverso le fasi pre-lancio alle fasi di mercato.

• Forte conoscenza del sistema sanitario tedesco (DACH) e una chiara comprensione dei contesti economici della salute, soprattutto per quanto riguarda i farmaci innovativi di specialità.

• Forte comprensione delle attuali questioni di politica sanitaria e dei possibili sviluppi futuri.

• Esperienza nel lavorare in team interfunzionali e prendere il comando per area personale di responsabilità.

• Volendo e in grado di contribuire regolarmente alle conoscenze e alle competenze del Market Access Team con un approccio proattivo e approfittando dell'ingresso e della rete dei colleghi.

• Forte leadership di progetto, gestione del progetto e competenze di gestione dei fornitori.

• Dimostrata influenza, consulenza e business partner competenze e un track record di lavoro in un ambiente frenetico.

• tedesco e inglese fluente per iscritto e parlare è un must.

Vantaggi

• Eccitanti opportunità di sviluppo e crescita professionale all'interno della nostra organizzazione dinamica.

• Un ambiente collaborativo e orientato alla soluzione in cui è possibile fare la differenza.

• Una cultura innovativa e aperta in un ambiente multiculturale.

• Uno stipendio competitivo e una varietà di benefici aggiuntivi.

• Un ufficio d'arte nel nostro quartier generale di Allschwil con opzioni di ufficio flessibili.

Paese: Svizzera

Orari: A tempo pieno
Tipo di lavoro: Permanente

We would love to welcome you in our team in Allschwil / Switzerland as

Associate Director Market Access and Public Affairs DACH (m/f/d)

(full-time; permanent)

About Idorsia

The purpose of Idorsia is to discover, develop and bring more innovative medicines to patients. We have more ideas; we see more opportunities and we want to help more patients. In order to achieve this, we would like to develop Idorsia into one of Europe’s leading biopharmaceutical companies, with a strong scientific core.

Idorsia is headquartered in Switzerland and has already established commercial operations in the US, Canada and major strategic locations in Europe.

With the commercial operations for the DACH region based in Munich/ Germany and Allschwil/ Switzerland, we are helping to realize Idorsia’s ambition of bringing innovative medicines from bench to bedside.

For more information see www.idorsia.com

Job Profile

Responsibilities of the Associate Director Market Access and Public Affairs DACH (m/f/d) include:

• Focuses on coordination and execution of Idorsia’s access strategy and its implementation (project management, oversees dossier writing, timelines, risks etc.) for defined therapeutic area.

• Ensures local fit of product value proposition (incl. evidence) to obtain ideal pricing and reimbursement scenarios and outcome.

• Represents Idorsia vis-à-vis local external agencies and other stakeholders , e.g. pharma association working groups and patient advocacy groups.

• Actively contributes to the internal Idorsia processes and contributes significantly to the conceptual development and implementation of country Market Access and Public Affairs strategies.

• Regularly exchanges information with the Senior Market Access and Public Affairs Director DACH and cross-functional project teams.

•
Drives development and implementation of country strategies to support DACH Market Access and Public Affairs.

•
Monitors the relevant regional policy environment and understands key healthcare trends and their impact.

•
Builds and maintains long-term relationships throughout the Idorsia DACH organization and with external regional counterparts.

•
Ensure adherence to all relevant legal, regulatory, and healthcare compliance requirements, corporate policies, and procedures, and drive this culture in the local organization.

Requirements

• Successfully completed a degree ideally in health economics, pharmacy, or science, or equivalent qualification.

• Minimum of 7 years of successful professional experience in DACH Market Access, and 10 years in the pharmaceutical industry.

• Profound knowledge and broad experience of Market Access (German AMNOG is a must, Switzerland an advantage) ideally in an innovative specialty pharma environment.

• Proven knowledge and experience in market access, pricing and reimbursement activities across DACH markets through pre-launch to in-market phases.

• Strong knowledge of the German (DACH) health care system and a clear understanding of health economic contexts, especially regarding innovative specialty pharmaceuticals.

• Strong understanding of current health policy issues and possible future developments.

• Experienced in working in cross-functional teams and taking the lead for personal area of responsibility.

• Willing and able to regularly contribute knowledge and expertise to the Market Access Team with a proactive approach and taking benefit from the input and network of colleagues.

• Strong project leadership, project management and vendor management skills.

• Demonstrated influencing, advisory and business partner skills and a track record working in a fast-paced environment.

• German and English fluent in writing and speaking is a must.

Benefits

• Exciting opportunities for development and professional growth within our dynamic organization.

• A collaborative and solution-oriented environment where you can make a difference.

• An innovative and open culture in a multicultural environment.

• A competitive salary and a variety of additional benefits.

• A state-of the art office in our Headquarters in Allschwil with flexible home office options.

Country: Switzerland
Business Area: Market Access
Schedule: Fulltime
Job Type: Permanent

Wir würden Sie gerne in unserem Team in Allschwil / Schweiz begrüßen als

Associate Director Market Access und Public Affairs DACH (m/w/d)

(Vollzeit; permanent)

Über Idorsia

Der Zweck von Idorsia ist es, innovativere Medikamente für Patienten zu entdecken, zu entwickeln und zu bringen. Wir haben mehr Ideen; wir sehen mehr Möglichkeiten und wir wollen mehr Patienten helfen. Um dies zu erreichen, möchten wir Idorsia zu einem der führenden biopharmazeutischen Unternehmen Europas mit einem starken wissenschaftlichen Kern entwickeln.

Idorsia hat seinen Hauptsitz in der Schweiz und hat bereits kommerzielle Aktivitäten in den USA, Kanada und wichtigen strategischen Standorten in Europa aufgebaut.

Mit den kommerziellen Aktivitäten für die DACH-Region mit Sitz in München/Deutschland und Allschwil/Schweiz tragen wir dazu bei, Idorsias Ambitionen zu verwirklichen, innovative Medikamente vom Tisch ins Bett zu bringen.

Für weitere Informationen siehe www.idorsia.com

Stellenprofil

Zu den Aufgaben des Associate Director Market Access und Public Affairs DACH (m/w/d) gehören:

• Konzentriert sich auf die Koordination und Durchführung der Idorsia-Zugangsstrategie und deren Umsetzung (Projektmanagement, überwacht das Verfassen von Dossiers, Zeitpläne, Risiken usw.) für den definierten therapeutischen Bereich.

• Gewährleistet die lokale Passung des Produktwertversprechens (einschließlich Evidenz), um ideale Preis- und Erstattungsszenarien und -ergebnisse zu erhalten.

• Repräsentiert Idorsia gegenüber lokalen externen Agenturen und anderen Interessengruppen, z. B. Arbeitsgruppen der Pharmavereinigung und Patientenvertretungsgruppen.

• Trägt aktiv zu den internen Idorsia-Prozessen bei und trägt wesentlich zur konzeptionellen Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Ländermarktzugangs- und Public Affairs-Strategien bei.

• Austauscht sich regelmäßig mit dem Senior Market Access und Public Affairs Director DACH und funktionsübergreifenden Projektteams.

•
Fördert die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Länderstrategien zur Unterstützung von DACH Market Access und Public Affairs.

•
Überwacht das relevante regionalpolitische Umfeld und versteht die wichtigsten Gesundheitstrends und ihre Auswirkungen.

•
Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen innerhalb der Idorsia DACH Organisation und mit externen regionalen Pendants.

•
Gewährleistung der Einhaltung aller relevanten rechtlichen, regulatorischen und Gesundheits-Compliance-Anforderungen, Unternehmensrichtlinien und -verfahren und Förderung dieser Kultur in der lokalen Organisation.

Anforderungen

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossen einen Abschluss idealerweise in Gesundheitsökonomie, Pharmazie oder Wissenschaft oder gleichwertige Qualifikation.

• Mindestens 7 Jahre erfolgreiche Berufserfahrung im DACH Marktzugang und 10 Jahre in der Pharmaindustrie.

• Tiefes Wissen und breite Erfahrung im Marktzugang (Deutsches AMNOG ist ein Muss, Schweiz ein Vorteil) ideal in einem innovativen Spezialpharmaumfeld.

• Nachgewiesenes Wissen und Erfahrung in den Bereichen Marktzugang, Preisgestaltung und Erstattungsaktivitäten in den DACH-Märkten durch Vorab- und In-Market-Phasen.

• Starke Kenntnisse des deutschen (DACH) Gesundheitssystems und ein klares Verständnis gesundheitsökonomischer Kontexte, insbesondere in Bezug auf innovative Spezialpharmazeutika.

• Starkes Verständnis für aktuelle gesundheitspolitische Themen und mögliche zukünftige Entwicklungen.

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit in funktionsübergreifenden Teams und der Führung im persönlichen Verantwortungsbereich.

• Bereit und in der Lage, regelmäßig Wissen und Know-how mit einem proaktiven Ansatz in das Market Access Team einzubringen und vom Input und Netzwerk der Kollegen zu profitieren.

• Starke Projektführung, Projektmanagement und Vendor Management Fähigkeiten.

• Demonstrierte Beeinflussungs-, Beratungs- und Geschäftspartnerfähigkeiten und eine Erfolgsbilanz in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld.

• Deutsch und Englisch fließend schreiben und sprechen ist ein Muss.

Vorteile

• Spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und berufliches Wachstum in unserer dynamischen Organisation.

• Eine kollaborative und lösungsorientierte Umgebung, in der Sie einen Unterschied machen können.

• Eine innovative und offene Kultur in einem multikulturellen Umfeld.

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und eine Vielzahl von zusätzlichen Vorteilen.

• Ein hochmodernes Büro in unserem Hauptsitz in Allschwil mit flexiblen Home-Office-Optionen.

Nous aimerions vous accueillir dans notre équipe à Allschwil / Suisse comme

Directeur associé Accès aux marchés et affaires publiques DACH (m/f/d)

(à temps plein; permanent)

Sur Idorsia

L'objectif d'Idorsia est de découvrir, développer et apporter des médicaments plus innovants aux patients. Nous avons plus d'idées, nous voyons plus de possibilités et nous voulons aider plus de patients. Pour y parvenir, nous aimerions faire de l'Idorsia l'une des plus grandes entreprises biopharmaceutiques d'Europe, avec un noyau scientifique fort.

Idorsia a son siège social en Suisse et a déjà mis en place des activités commerciales aux États-Unis, au Canada et dans les principaux sites stratégiques en Europe.

Avec les opérations commerciales pour la région DACH basée à Munich/Allemagne et Allschwil/Suisse, nous contribuons à réaliser l'ambition d'Idorsia d'apporter des médicaments innovants du banc au chevet.

Pour plus d'informations, voir www.idorsia.com

Profil d'emploi

Responsabilités du directeur associé Accès aux marchés et affaires publiques DACH (m/f/d) :

• Se concentre sur la coordination et l'exécution de la stratégie d'accès d'Idorsia et sa mise en œuvre (gestion de projet, supervision de la rédaction des dossiers, échéanciers, risques, etc.) pour un domaine thérapeutique défini.

• Assurer l'ajustement local de la proposition de valeur du produit (y compris les preuves) pour obtenir des scénarios et des résultats de prix et de remboursement idéaux.

• Représente Idorsia auprès des agences externes locales et d'autres parties prenantes, par exemple les groupes de travail des associations pharmaceutiques et les groupes de défense des patients.

• contribue activement aux processus internes d'Idorsia et contribue de manière significative à l'élaboration et à la mise en œuvre de stratégies nationales d'accès aux marchés et d'affaires publiques.

• Échange régulièrement de l'information avec le directeur principal de l'accès au marché et des affaires publiques, DACH, et les équipes de projet interfonctionnelles.

•
Dirige l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies nationales pour soutenir l'accès aux marchés et les affaires publiques du DACH.

•
Surveille l'environnement politique régional pertinent et comprend les principales tendances en matière de soins de santé et leur impact.

•
Établir et maintenir des relations à long terme dans l'ensemble de l'organisation Idorsia DACH et avec des homologues régionaux externes.

•
Veiller au respect de toutes les exigences légales, réglementaires et de conformité en matière de soins de santé, des politiques et procédures de l'organisation, et favoriser cette culture au sein de l'organisation locale.

Exigences

• A réussi un diplôme idéalement en économie de la santé, en pharmacie ou en sciences, ou une qualification équivalente.

• Au moins 7 ans d'expérience professionnelle réussie dans l'accès au marché DACH et 10 ans dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.

• Connaissance approfondie et vaste expérience de l'accès au marché (l'AMNOG allemand est un must, la Suisse un avantage) idéalement dans un environnement pharmaceutique spécialisé innovant.

• Connaissances et expérience éprouvées en matière d'accès aux marchés, de tarification et de remboursement sur les marchés de DACH grâce à une phase préalable de lancement sur le marché.

• Connaissance approfondie du système de soins de santé allemand (DACH) et compréhension claire des contextes économiques de la santé, en particulier en ce qui concerne les produits pharmaceutiques spécialisés innovants.

• Une bonne compréhension des enjeux actuels de la politique de santé et des développements futurs possibles.

• Expérience dans le travail en équipes interfonctionnelles et la prise de responsabilités personnelles.

• Volontaire et capable de fournir régulièrement des connaissances et de l'expertise à l'équipe d'accès au marché avec une approche proactive et en tirant parti des commentaires et du réseau de collègues.

• Fort leadership de projet, gestion de projet et compétences en gestion des fournisseurs.

• Démonstration de compétences en matière d'influence, de consultation et de partenariat d'affaires et d'un travail de longue date dans un environnement à rythme rapide.

• L'allemand et l'anglais parlent couramment l'écriture et la parole.

Avantages

• Des possibilités de perfectionnement et de développement professionnel passionnantes au sein de notre organisation dynamique.

• Un environnement collaboratif et axé sur la solution où vous pouvez faire la différence.

• Une culture innovante et ouverte dans un environnement multiculturel.

• Un salaire concurrentiel et divers avantages supplémentaires.

• Un bureau à la pointe de la technologie dans notre siège à Allschwil avec des options de bureau à domicile flexibles.

Informazioni su Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd

Con sede nei pressi di Basilea, Svizzera – un hub biotecnologico europeo – Idorsia ha un team di professionisti altamente esperti, che copre tutte le discipline da panchina a comodino; QUVIQTM (daridorexant), un diverso tipo di trattamento insonnia con il potenziale di rivoluzionare questa crescente preoccupazione per la salute pubblica; partner forti per massimizzare il valore del nostro portafoglio; un promettente pipeline di sviluppo interno; e un motore di scoperta di farmaci specializzati focalizzato sul cambiamento di piccole dimensioni

Stiamo cercando un VP, Capo di Accesso Globale, Valore e Prezzi per aderire alla società!

Responsabilità del lavoro

Il VP , Responsabile Accesso Globale, Valore e Prezzi è responsabile per la definizione e la guida della strategia globale di accesso al mercato, valore e prezzi per l'oleodotto prioritario e il lancio di beni nel loro ciclo di vita.

Il ruolo serve come rappresentante globale dell'accesso al mercato all'interno di team di asset multifunzionali, assicurando che i requisiti dei pagamenti siano incorporati nello sviluppo dei prodotti, nella generazione delle prove, nella pianificazione del lancio, nelle strategie di pricing e nella gestione del ciclo di vita per facilitare l'accesso tempestivo dei pazienti e massimizzare il valore patrimoniale.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di Commercial, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance e Regional Access, il ruolo traduce i requisiti di pagamento complessi e di rimborso in strategie globali attuabili e consente una riuscita esecuzione locale.

• Definire e condurre strategie di accesso al mercato globale dal primo sviluppo attraverso il lancio e la gestione del ciclo di vita.

• Agire come rappresentante di accesso al mercato di base sui team di asset globali e fornire la leadership di accesso strategico attraverso le funzioni.

• Incorporare i requisiti del payer nei profili di prodotto di destinazione, piani di sviluppo clinico, strategie di prodotto integrate e sequenziamento delle indicazioni.

• Fornire input di accesso su endpoint clinici, comparatori, popolazioni bersaglio, misure di risultati e piani di generazione di prove.

• Sviluppare le roadmap di prova focalizzate sul payer allineate con le pietre miliari di sviluppo e obiettivi di lancio.

• Costruire robuste proposizioni di valore payer su misura per il rimborso chiave e Health Technology Assessment (HTA) stakeholders.

• Progettare ed eseguire roadmap di accesso globali integrate che coprono il rimborso, la convenienza, i prezzi e le considerazioni di accesso.

• Identificare le potenziali barriere di accesso al mercato e sviluppare strategie di mitigazione basate sulle intuizioni dei payer e sulle politiche sanitarie in evoluzione.

• La ricerca del payer di piombo, le valutazioni di accesso competitivo e le analisi del paesaggio di rimborso sui mercati prioritari.

• Progettazione di soluzioni di accesso innovative, tra cui accordi di ingresso gestiti, accordi basati sul valore, programmi di supporto del paziente e iniziative di convenienza.

• Assicurare le strategie di accesso sono conformi e adattabili ai sistemi sanitari regionali e locali.

• Co-promuovere lo sviluppo della strategia globale dei prezzi in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interfunzionali.

• Stabilire e sostenere i framework di governance dei prezzi per ottimizzare le decisioni sui prezzi globali e locali.

• Valutare e gestire i rischi dei prezzi, comprese le implicazioni internazionali dei prezzi di riferimento e l'impatto del mercato a valle.

• Sviluppare e mantenere i principali servizi di accesso a livello globale, tra cui Global Value Dossiers, payer value deck, value narrative e materiali di rimborso.

• Creare strumenti di accesso globale e sostenere le squadre regionali e di paese con impegno payer, presentazioni, trattative e preparazione di lancio.

• Partner con team di previsione e finanza per garantire le ipotesi di accesso si riflettono in previsioni commerciali e pianificazione aziendale.

• Monitorare la politica sanitaria, il rimborso, HTA e gli sviluppi normativi e tradurre le implicazioni in raccomandazioni strategiche.

• Sostenere le attività di prontezza di lancio per garantire l'impegno di pagamento di successo e l'esecuzione di accesso al mercato.

• Rappresentare la prospettiva di accesso globale nelle discussioni di governance, team di asset e partenariati esterni, se del caso.

• Guidare l'allineamento tra i team globali, regionali e locali per garantire strategie di accesso costanti ed efficaci sui mercati.

Laurea in scienze della vita, economia della salute, economia, economia aziendale, sanità pubblica, o una disciplina relativa.

Esperienza significativa nell'accesso al mercato, nei prezzi, nella strategia di valore o nell'ambito dell'industria farmaceutica o biotecnologica.

Dimostrato successo che conduce complesse iniziative interfunzionali all'interno di organizzazioni di matrice.

About Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd

Headquartered near Basel, Switzerland – a European biotech hub – Idorsia has a highly experienced team of dedicated professionals, covering all disciplines from bench to bedside; QUVIVIQ™ (daridorexant), a different kind of insomnia treatment with the potential to revolutionize this mounting public health concern; strong partners to maximize the value of our portfolio; a promising in-house development pipeline; and a specialized drug discovery engine focused on small-molecule drugs that can change the treatment paradigm for many patients.

We are looking for a VP, Head of Global Access, Value and Pricing to join the company!

Job Responsibilities

The VP , Head of Global Access, Value & Pricing is responsible for defining and driving the global market access, value, and pricing strategy for priority pipeline and launch assets across their lifecycle.

The role serves as the global market access representative within cross-functional asset teams, ensuring payer requirements are embedded into product development, evidence generation, launch planning, pricing strategies, and lifecycle management to facilitate timely patient access and maximize asset value.

Working closely with Commercial, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, and Regional Access teams, the role translates complex payer and reimbursement requirements into actionable global strategies and enables successful local execution.

• Define and lead global market access strategies from early development through launch and lifecycle management.

• Act as the core market access representative on global asset teams and provide strategic access leadership across functions.

• Embed payer requirements into target product profiles, clinical development plans, integrated product strategies, and indication sequencing.

• Provide access input on clinical endpoints, comparators, target populations, outcomes measures, and evidence-generation plans.

• Develop payer-focused evidence roadmaps aligned with development milestones and launch objectives.

• Build robust payer value propositions tailored to key reimbursement and Health Technology Assessment (HTA) stakeholders.

• Design and execute integrated global access roadmaps covering reimbursement, affordability, pricing, and access considerations.

• Identify potential market access barriers and develop mitigation strategies based on payer insights and evolving healthcare policies.

• Lead payer research, competitive access assessments, and reimbursement landscape analyses across priority markets.

• Design innovative access solutions, including managed entry agreements, value-based arrangements, patient support programs, and affordability initiatives.

• Ensure access strategies are compliant and adaptable to regional and local healthcare systems.

• Co-lead global pricing strategy development in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Establish and support pricing governance frameworks to optimize global and local pricing decisions.

• Assess and manage pricing risks, including international reference pricing implications and downstream market impact.

• Develop and maintain key global access deliverables, including Global Value Dossiers, payer value decks, value narratives, and reimbursement materials.

• Create global access toolkits and support regional and country teams with payer engagement, submissions, negotiations, and launch preparation.

• Partner with forecasting and finance teams to ensure access assumptions are reflected in commercial forecasts and business planning.

• Monitor healthcare policy, reimbursement, HTA, and regulatory developments and translate implications into strategic recommendations.

• Support launch readiness activities to ensure successful payer engagement and market access execution.

• Represent the global access perspective in governance discussions, asset teams, and external partnerships where appropriate.

• Drive alignment between Global, Regional, and Local teams to ensure consistent and effective access strategies across markets.

Candidate's Requirements

•
University degree in Life Sciences, Health Economics, Economics, Business Administration, Public Health, or a related discipline.

•
Significant experience in Market Access, Pricing, Value Strategy, or Reimbursement within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

•
Proven experience shaping market access strategies for pipeline and launch assets.

•
Strong understanding of healthcare systems, reimbursement pathways, payer decision-making, and Health Technology Assessment (HTA) processes across major markets.

•
Experience integrating payer requirements into clinical development, evidence generation, and commercialization planning.

•
Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives within matrix organizations.

•
Strong knowledge of global pricing strategy development and pricing governance principles.

•
Experience supporting launch readiness and commercialization activities for innovative therapies.

•
Strong analytical capabilities and ability to translate clinical, economic, and real-world evidence into compelling payer value propositions.

•
Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

•
Ability to align diverse stakeholders without direct authority.

•
Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills within complex healthcare environments.

•
Experience collaborating across global, regional, and local organizations.

•
Strong understanding of reimbursement, affordability, and patient access challenges across international markets.

•
Payer engagement and negotiation experience preferred.

•
Experience in Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) considered a strong advantage.

•
Experience contributing to economic models, value dossiers, real-world evidence strategies, and payer evidence planning desirable.

À propos d'Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd

Basé près de Bâle, en Suisse – un pôle européen de biotechnologie – Idorsia dispose d'une équipe hautement expérimentée de professionnels dévoués, couvrant toutes les disciplines du banc au chevet; QUVIVIQTM (daridorexant), un traitement d'insomnie différent avec le potentiel de révolutionner cette préoccupation croissante de santé publique; des partenaires forts pour maximiser la valeur de notre portefeuille; un pipeline de développement interne prometteur; et un moteur de découverte de médicaments spécialisé axé sur les médicaments à petites molécules qui peuvent changer le paradigme de traitement pour de nombreux patients.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un vice-président, responsable de l'accès mondial, de la valeur et du prix pour rejoindre l'entreprise!

Responsabilités professionnelles

Le vice-président , responsable de l'accès mondial, de la valeur et des prix, est chargé de définir et de piloter la stratégie d'accès au marché mondial, de valeur et de prix pour les pipelines prioritaires et de lancer des actifs tout au long de leur cycle de vie.

En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement commercial, clinique, médical, réglementaire, financière et d'accès régional, le rôle traduit les exigences complexes du payeur et du remboursement en stratégies globales réalisables et permet une exécution locale réussie.

• Définir et diriger les stratégies mondiales d'accès aux marchés depuis le développement précoce jusqu'au lancement et à la gestion du cycle de vie.

• Agir en tant que principal représentant de l'accès aux marchés dans les équipes mondiales d'actifs et fournir un leadership stratégique en matière d'accès à l'ensemble des fonctions.

• Intégrer les exigences des payeurs dans les profils de produits cibles, les plans de développement clinique, les stratégies intégrées des produits et le séquençage des indications.

• Fournir des commentaires sur les paramètres cliniques, les comparateurs, les populations cibles, les mesures des résultats et les plans de production de données probantes.

Are you passionate about patient safety and ensuring that medicines are monitored to the highest standards? As a Drug Safety Case Manager, you will play a critical role in safeguarding patients by ensuring accurate and timely management of safety information throughout the product lifecycle.

Working within a collaborative and highly skilled Drug Safety team, you will take ownership of adverse event case management activities while partnering closely with physicians, clinical teams, regulatory colleagues, and external partners to ensure compliance with global pharmacovigilance requirements.

Your Responsibilities:

Case Management & Safety Reporting

• Manage adverse event cases from receipt through submission, including triage, data entry, medical coding, narrative writing, quality review, and expedited reporting for both clinical trial and post-marketing cases

• Prioritize and process safety cases in accordance with global regulations, SOPs, and reporting timelines

• Identify missing or incomplete information and coordinate follow-up activities with Drug Safety Physicians and other stakeholders

• Monitor case workflows to ensure efficient and compliant case processing

• Support or oversee reconciliation activities to ensure data consistency across systems

Clinical Trial & Cross-Functional Support

• Contribute to the successful set-up of new clinical studies by providing safety reporting documentation, reconciliation plans, monitoring guidance, and TMF documentation

• Support SAE reconciliation activities between clinical and safety databases

• Coordinate SUSAR notifications to investigators and Ethics Committees

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including CROs, to establish and maintain safety agreements and processes

What You'll Bring:

• Degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related healthcare discipline

• Minimum 5 years of experience in drug safety case management

• Strong understanding of medical terminology, disease processes, and safety databases

• Experience with medical coding dictionaries and safety reporting systems

• Good knowledge of EU and US pharmacovigilance regulations and reporting requirements

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines

• Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a collaborative mindset

• Fluent English, both written and spoken

• EU/EFTA citizenship is required due to permit restrictions

Why Join Us?

This role offers the opportunity to make a direct impact on patient safety while working in a dynamic, international environment. You will collaborate with experienced professionals across clinical development and pharmacovigilance, contribute to innovative clinical programs, and play a key role in ensuring the safe use of medicines.

Work Location: Allschwil, Switzerland

Business Area: Global Business Development, Drug Safety

Schedule: Fulltime

Job Type: Permanent

Job ID : 4790

We encourage all potential candidates with diverse backgrounds of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, and disability to submit their job applications. All applicants will receive consideration.

We are committed to fostering respect, fairness, and equal opportunities for all job applicants and our employees.

Please be informed that if you are selected for this position, your employment will be subject to a pre-employment background screening process, of which you would be informed in greater detail in due course.

Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd ("Idorsia") is committed to a fair and transparent application process. In order to avoid any conflict of interest in line with Idorsia Code of Business Conduct, which would undermine such a commitment, the applicants must disclose any personal, financial, or other outside interests interfering with the interests of Idorsia. Headquartered near Basel, Switzerland – a European biotech hub – Idorsia has a highly experienced team of dedicated professionals, covering all disciplines from bench to bedside; QUVIVIQ™ (daridorexant), a different kind of insomnia treatment with the potential to revolutionize this mounting public health concern; strong partners to maximize the value of our portfolio; a promising in-house development pipeline; and a specialized drug discovery engine focused on small-molecule drugs that can change the treatment paradigm for many patients.

• Develop global brand strategies, positioning, segmentation, messaging architecture, and stakeholder engagement plans.

• Translate clinical differentiation into compelling value propositions for healthcare professionals, patients, payers, and health systems.

The purpose of Idorsia is to discover, develop, and commercialize innovative medicines to help more patients.

You will work closely with experienced HR professionals and gain insights into various aspects of the HR function while building a strong operational foundation.

HR Operations & Administration

• Assist with general administrative HR activities and day-to-day operations

• Support the management and organization of employee records, including scanning, filing, and archiving

Project & Functional Support

In addition to operational tasks, you will have the opportunity to support HR initiatives across different areas, which may evolve over time, such as:

• Contributing to projects in areas like Talent Development, Talent Acquisition, or Employee Benefits

• Assisting with research, documentation, and internal communication materials

• Participating in process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field or completed HR apprenticeship

• Motivation to learn and contribute in both operational and project-based environments

• Structured, detail-oriented, and well-organized working style

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills

• Good MS Office skills (Excel, Word, Outlook)

• Fluent in English and German

• You have solid academic or vocational foundation in HR

• You are curious and eager to broaden your understanding of HR beyond theory

• You are comfortable contributing to essential operational work while learning on the job

• A structured entry opportunity into the HR profession
